from pathlib import Path
base=bytearray.fromhex('8002000000330000012a40000001000000094000000900000000000006586d1a65a6ce000e01bfffdd00040400041f00000008')
# attrs offset from parse
pos=10+4; autharea=int.from_bytes(base[pos:pos+4],'big'); pos+=4+autharea; authsz=int.from_bytes(base[pos:pos+2],'big'); pos+=2+authsz; pisz=int.from_bytes(base[pos:pos+2],'big'); pos+=2
print('pos', pos, 'attrs_off', pos+6, base[pos:pos+14].hex())
attrs = 0x04060006 # ORDERLY + OWNERREAD + OWNERWRITE + AUTHWRITE? low no NT bits
b=base[:]
b[pos+6:pos+10]=attrs.to_bytes(4,'big')
b[-2:]=(500).to_bytes(2,'big')
Path('/workspace/poc_nv_orderly_ordinary_500.bin').write_bytes(b)
print(len(b), b.hex())
PY
